paper.title: Quiet-STaR: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Think Before Speaking

result.summary: 本文提出 Quiet-STaR，将 STaR 从问答数据集推广到任意文本，让语言模型在每个 token 处生成内部理由（rationale）以帮助预测后续文本 [abstract][S1.p2]。方法包含并行理由生成、混合头（mixing head）以及基于 REINFORCE 的理由优化三个步骤 [S4.SS1.p1]。在 Mistral 7B 上使用 OpenWebMath 和 C4 继续预训练后，模型在无需下游任务微调的情况下，零样本 GSM8K 从 5.9% 提升到 10.9%，CommonsenseQA 从 36.3% 提升到 47.2% [abstract][S1.p3]。作者认为 Quiet-STaR 是迈向更通用、可扩展推理学习的一步 [abstract][S7.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：既然推理隐含在几乎所有文本中，能否利用语言建模任务本身来教模型推理，而不是依赖精心整理的问答数据集 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。作者指出，STaR 等方法依赖人工整理的 QA 数据集，限制了理由的规模和泛化性，因此希望让模型从大规模互联网文本中学习生成有助于推断后续文本的推理 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: We instead ask, if reasoning is implicit in all text, why shouldn’t we leverage the task of language modeling to teach reasoning?
Yet, training from curated QA datasets limits the scale and generalizability of the rationales.
we train an LM to generate reasoning that helps it infer future text from a large internet text corpus

method.text: Quiet-STaR 在每对相邻 token 之间引入辅助的理由变量，目标是让模型生成中间思考以更好地预测剩余序列 [S3.p1]。方法包含三步：在所有 token 位置并行生成理由并插入可学习的思考起止 token；用混合头决定后理由预测与基础预测的融合权重；用 REINFORCE 优化理由生成，并采用教师强制技巧将多个未来 token 纳入损失 [S4.SS1.p1]。作者还使用非短视（non-myopic）目标，即预测多个后续 token 而非仅下一个 token [S3.p1][S4.SS4.SSS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: we introduce an auxiliary ‘rationale’ variable between each pair of observed tokens of the sequence
In parallel across $n$ tokens $x_{i}$ in an input sequence $x_{0:n}$, we generate $r$ rationales of length $t$
we train a ”mixing head” – a shallow MLP producing a weight determining how much the post-rationale next-token predicted logits should be incorporated
We use REINFORCE to provide a learning signal to rationales based on their impact on future-token prediction.
we apply a teacher-forcing trick to include in the loss the likelihood of predicting not only the token after the thought but also later tokens
we formulate the objective as accurately predicting the remaining sequence, rather than only the next token

experiments.text: 实验以 Mistral 7B 为基础模型，主要在 OpenWebMath 上训练，并在 C4 上评估 [S5.p1][S5.p2]。下游评估使用 CommonsenseQA 和 GSM8K 的零样本设置，不进行任务微调 [S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS1.p3]。C4 评估使用 16 个思考 token 和 4 个真实 token 前瞻 [S5.SS1.p2]。此外还进行了链式思考实验，使用零样本提示“Let’s think step by step.”，在 128 个 GSM8K 测试样本上以温度 0.7 采样 8 次并取多数投票 [S5.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: We conduct all of our experiments starting with the base version of Mistral 7B.
We perform most of our experiments by training on OpenWebMath
We also evaluate Quiet-STaR on C4
we evaluate the extent to which Quiet-STaR improves the zero-shot reasoning capabilities of the language model on CommonsenseQA and GSM8K
unlike, we do not fine-tune on the downstream tasks
we train Mistral 7B with 16 thought tokens and 4 true tokens ahead
we used a zero-shot prompt (“Let’s think step by step.”) without in-context examples
The majority vote accuracy over 8 samples (cot-maj@8) increases from 40.6% to 47.7% with Quiet-STaR, as evaluated on a sample of 128 GSM8K test items.
each chain-of-thought solution is sampled with temperature 0.7

findings.text: 在 OpenWebMath 上训练后，Quiet-STaR 在零样本 CommonsenseQA 上提升 10.9%，在 GSM8K 上提升 5.0%，且提升随理由 token 数增加而持续增大 [S5.SS1.p1]。在 C4 上训练也带来提升，但幅度较小：GSM8K 从 5.9% 到 8.1%，CommonsenseQA 从 36.3% 到 42.6% [S5.SS1.p2]。思考对困难 token 的预测帮助不成比例地大，大多数 token 不受影响 [S5.SS2.p1][A7.p1]。在零样本链式思考中，内部理由使多数投票准确率从 40.6% 提升到 47.7% [S5.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: On CommonsenseQA, we find that Quiet-STaR improves performance by 10.9% compared to the base language model.
on GSM8K, Quiet-STaR results in a 5.0% boost over the base model
this improvement consistently increases with the number of tokens used in the model’s rationales
training with Quiet-STaR on C4 also improves performance on GSM8K ( $5.9\%\rightarrow 8.1\%$) and CommonsenseQA ( $36.3\%\rightarrow 42.6\%$) but by a smaller margin
there is a disproportionate improvement on more difficult tokens
The distribution is skewed, with most tokens unaffected, while a small fraction of hard tokens see substantial improvements from the thoughts.
The majority vote accuracy over 8 samples (cot-maj@8) increases from 40.6% to 47.7% with Quiet-STaR

limitations.text: 作者指出，为应对各种元学习挑战而做了简化，例如尚不清楚这些技术从零训练模型时是否有效，且只应用到了 70 亿参数模型 [S6.p1]。Quiet-STaR 在生成每个额外 token 前需生成大量 token，带来显著开销 [S6.p2]。当前实现不支持动态预测何时生成或结束理由 [S6.p2]。此外，无法确知模型用语言表达的推理是否忠实反映其内部处理，且对有害或有偏推理模式没有防护措施 [Sx1.p1]。

evidence.quote: it would be valuable to understand whether these techniques work when a model is trained from scratch
We have also only applied Quiet-STaR to a 7 billion parameter model
Quiet-STaR results in a substantial overhead, generating many tokens before generating every additional token.
In the current implementation we do not support dynamically predicting when to generate, or end, a rationale.
it is impossible to know that the reasoning expressed by the model in language accurately represents the internal processing of the model
there are no safeguards against harmful or biased reasoning patterns if the model finds them useful
